blockers.detail: nts_ke_process_receive gained 3 params (errbuf, errlng, errtxt): (BufCtl_t*, int*) -> (BufCtl_t*, int*, char*, int, const char**); FuzzServer.c still calls it with 2 args, so it no longer compiles (too few arguments)

setup.o must precede libntpd_lib.a on the link line so its stub definitions win over the archive members; the old Makefile put the setup object last, so the stubs were never used and the daemon symbols got pulled in

new daemon symbol record_ntske_log (declared in include/ntpd.h, now with an extra int aead param) is referenced by the NTS parsers; harness setup.c provides no stub, so the link pulls ntp_util/ntp_filegen/ntp_control out of libntpd_lib.a and fails

evidence: M diff (ecc1b5ef974d, verified from local git): include/nts.h changes nts_ke_process_receive from (BufCtl_t*, int*) to (BufCtl_t*, int*, char *errbuf, int errlng, const char **errtxt) - 2 args to 5 args; ntpd/nts_server.c call site updated to the 5-arg form at line 422
M diff also adds record_ntske_log(NTSKE_Status, const char*, const char*, double, double, double, const char*) to include/ntpd.h (declaration) and implements it in ntpd/ntp_util.c

H diff (a70f55cc2b85, verified via .patch) touches exactly three things in one commit: FuzzServer.c call updated to 5 args (api), Makefile reorders the LIB variable so the setup object comes before ntpd_lib (link order), setup.c gains the record_ntske_log stub (missing symbol)
H commit message: 'This PR fixes the build for ntpsec on linkage and API changes.' - the fix itself is described as having both an api and a linkage component
h(M^1) harness at oss-fuzz rev b3b6acdca105: FuzzServer.c:34 still calls nts_ke_process_receive(&buf, &aead) with 2 args; Makefile:21 has $(setup_inc) last; setup.c has no record_ntske_log

rationale.zh: 同一个库变更（ntpsec ecc1b5ef974d）同时从两个维度击穿了 harness：一是 API 维度——`nts_ke_process_receive` 从 2 参改为 5 参（新增 errbuf/errlng/errtxt），旧 FuzzServer.c 仍按 2 参调用，直接编译失败；二是构建/链接维度——库新增的 `record_ntske_log`（并且签名也多了 `int aead`）被 NTS 解析代码引用，harness 没有对应 stub，同时旧 Makefile 把 `setup.o` 放在链接行末尾，导致 stub 无法覆盖 libntpd_lib.a 里的成员，从而把 ntp_util/ntp_filegen/ntp_control 一并拖进链接。修复 H 在**一个提交里同时**改了调用参数（api）、调整链接行中 setup 对象的位置（链接顺序）并补上 `record_ntske_log` stub（缺失符号），三类修复合起来才恢复构建。因为没有任何单一类别能独立修复，按 schema 归为 mix（components = api + configuration），显式可见（编译/链接失败）。
rationale.en: One library change (ntpsec ecc1b5ef974d) breaks the harness along two axes at once. API axis: nts_ke_process_receive went from 2 to 5 parameters (errbuf/errlng/errtxt), and the old FuzzServer.c still calls it with 2, so it fails to compile. Build/link axis: the newly introduced record_ntske_log (itself gaining an int aead parameter) is referenced by the NTS parsers while the harness supplies no stub, and the old Makefile placed the setup object last on the link line so the stubs could not override the libntpd_lib.a members, pulling ntp_util/ntp_filegen/ntp_control into the link. Fix H changes all three in a single commit: the call arguments (api), the link-object ordering (link order), and a new record_ntske_log stub (missing symbol). No single category alone restores the build, so this is labelled mix (components = api + configuration), explicitly visible as a compile/link failure.
